Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Homoncular Servant
Harbingers of Skulls/
Retainer
Requires a Harbinger of Skulls
1 life
When there is no acting minion, this Harbinger of Skulls  may tap this retainer to untap.
As  above, and this Harbinger of Skulls  may tap this retainer to gain +1 bleed as an action modifier.

Harbingers do have Necromancy Rituals (from the online materials I've found) that would allow them to have effectively necromantic hands to do some of their bidding. This may include helping destroy others property or performing menial tasks for them, hence the two abilities.

It's meant to give them a little free untap (not usable as a 'wake') and some extra go-forward.

Thoughts?

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Here's a nerf (and I fixed the typo in the name)

Name: Homuncular Servant
Cardtype: Retainer
Clan: Harbinger of Skulls
Cost: 1 pool
Zombie with 1 life.
[nec] You may tap this retainer at the end of a successful action this Harbinger of Skulls performs to untap him or her.
[NEC] As above, and you may tap this retainer to give this Harbinger of Skulls +1 bleed for the current action.

1 pool seems balanced for the dual effect.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
